source.basis: Operator facility page; structured facts only, no operator prose reproduced.

reading.body:
The Flexential Nashville – Cool Springs campus in Franklin, Tennessee publishes 3.15 MW of IT capacity across 74,679 square feet of technical space. At 10 kW per rack, a common colocation density, 3.15 MW supports roughly 315 racks; at 40 kW per rack, a common AI training density, the same power supports roughly 79 racks. Those are assumptions about rack density, not operator claims. The campus does not publish a total power figure separate from its IT capacity figure, and no GPU count or AI-specific configuration is published.

The certification stack, SOC 1 Type 2, SOC 2 Type 2, PCI DSS, HIPAA, ISO 27001, HITRUST, and SSAE 18, qualifies the campus to host financial transaction processing, payment card workloads, regulated health data, and broadly security-audited enterprise IT. That profile points toward compliance-sensitive workloads rather than large-scale AI training, which typically prioritizes raw power density over audit coverage.

Among the 24 facilities this site has mapped in Tennessee, only 4 publish a megawatt figure, and their combined published IT capacity is 12.13 MW. This campus, at 3.15 MW, ranks second among those four by published capacity, representing roughly 26 percent of the published Tennessee total this site has read. That share reflects the limits of what operators disclose, not a census of all capacity in the state. At 3.15 MW, the campus is a modest presence for AI at scale, and its compliance certifications suggest its primary value is regulated enterprise workloads rather than frontier model training.
